title: Neutral Entry--Exit Cycles with Quadratic Grazing: Uniform Return Reduction and Local Two-Parameter Bifurcations
summary: We study planar continuous piecewise-smooth slow--fast return circuits in which an invariant-line entry--exit passage is followed by a separated quadratic grazing and the reference cycle has unit multiplier. We first prove that the physical entry--exit map for positive slow parameter extends, uniformly to any prescribed finite order, to the singular parameter, including nonvertical endpoint fibers.
